summary: Kingsway Financial Services Inc. (registrant) filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, Kingsway Warranty Holdings LLC, sold all equity interests of Trinity Warranty Solutions LLC to Trinity Warranty Holding LLC. The aggregate consideration is $5 million cash at closing plus $3 million in secured subordinated promissory notes due in ten years, subject to customary working capital adjustments. The sale closed on May 8, 2026. Representations, warranties, and indemnification provisions include a $50,000 deductible and $500,000 liability cap. What to watch: potential indemnification claims and collection risk on the seller-financed note.
